description: This file defines the KpiServiceException class, which is a custom exception class used within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin to handle KPI service related errors, specifically for situations such as when minimum ratings are greater than maximum ratings.

classes.name: KpiServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in Exception to handle KPI service related errors within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin.

methods.name: minGreaterThanMax
methods.description: Returns a new instance of KpiServiceException with a specific message indicating that the minimum rating should be less than the maximum rating.
